text: The system shall ingest candidate resumes, cover letters, and application form responses to produce an automated recruitment suitability score.
The system shall disclose to applicants and recruiters that AI is being used to support screening decisions and provide an explanation of the main factors affecting the score.
The system shall generate AI-written interview feedback emails and label the content as AI-generated before it is sent to applicants.
The system shall use emotion recognition during employee video interviews to infer confidence, stress, and cultural fit.
The system shall maintain technical documentation describing the intended purpose, model design, training data sources, validation results, risk controls, and monitoring plan.
The system shall monitor deployed model performance, bias metrics, data drift, and override rates after release and trigger corrective action when thresholds are exceeded.
The system shall record and escalate serious incidents that may affect health, safety, or fundamental rights and support reporting to the relevant authority.
